invalid_shortcuts.generic_constant_maps: Generic constant matrices in a local left-invariant frame are not global typed maps without the missing transition/section convention.
invalid_shortcuts.q79_character: The q79 CP character restricts finite holonomy/channel support; it is not the rank-three bundle transition system rho_E.
